messages.subject: Deployment error
parts:
I would be grateful if anyone could point me to some resource for solving this problem; I have a fully functioning Shiny app that works lovely on my computer. I have succesfully deployed Shiny apps earlier but with this app I get this deployment error. What baffles me are the references to Linux and Ubuntu as I am working on a WIndows 7. The locale error at the end seems to be only a warning, but apparently the critical error is the one listed earlier: ERROR: configuration failed for package �sys�. If it is of any relevance I had to install the sys package today as when I first tried to deploy the app I got a message saying that the app depends on the package sys which was not installed (so I installed it).

I tried to deploy from RStudio and my system locale is the following if it matters:

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Deployment error
parts:
The shinyapps.io environment runs on Ubuntu (a variety of Linux).

In that environment, AppArmor is not installed. As it is a requirement of the sys package, attempting to use sys fails.

What package are you using that in turn requires sys? What is the output of rsconnect::appDependencies()?

messages.subject: Re: Deployment error
